EternaBond RoofSeal tape is commonly used on EPDM roofs and can be a good repair for a 5 ft slit, but it is not guaranteed to be permanent. Clean the area thoroughly with the recommended cleaner and let it dry, make sure the EPDM surface is free of dirt, oils, and debris, and apply the tape with firm pressure, rolling it down to remove air bubbles. Cover the full length of the slit with at least a few inches of overlap on each side, and round or cut the ends so there are no sharp corners that can lift. Pick the right product for EPDM, since some EternaBond versions are designed for specific membranes, and check the manufacturer's compatibility guidance. Cold, wet, or dusty conditions can prevent proper adhesion, so apply it in mild, dry weather with the surface above the minimum temperature on the label. Also check whether the slit is from aging, shrinkage, or a puncture, because a crack caused by a failing membrane may keep reopening, and a roofer may recommend a full patch or replacement. Inspect the repair periodically and recoat or re-seal if edges start to lift.
